name: rcore_app
description: Frappe compose template for the polaris docker product (composes an app named rcore)

modules.name: base
modules._comment: Required by polaris: corporate/polaris/frappe's Loan and LoanTransfer doctypes have Link fields with options="Branch", and Branch is only defined in this module. Without composing it, polaris's doctype links would fail to resolve.

modules.name: polaris
modules._comment: crm is a hard requirement alongside polaris: polaris's loan_application KYC validation and credit-decision engine read Lead.kyc_status (the crm module's unprefixed Lead doctype), so this template must always compose the crm module too.

modules.name: crm
modules._comment: Core CRM slice (leads, opportunities, prospects, campaigns, appointments, contracts, sales notes/tasks, statuses) from the productivity SDK, using unprefixed doctype names (Lead, Opportunity, Prospect, ...). Composing this module replaces installing a standalone CRM app — a site should NOT have frappe/crm installed alongside rcore; rcore's own modules (e.g. polaris's Lead.kyc_status reads) are wired to this module's unprefixed doctypes, not to frappe/crm's 'CRM '-prefixed ones. Existing sites need one 'bench execute rcore.patches.crm_seed_defaults.execute' to seed default statuses.
